name: Vásárosnamény (Hungary)
description: A vertical tan banner charged near the top with the town arms of Vásárosnamény: a quartered blue, red and white shield with a tree, a wavy stripe, a plant and a crown, inscribed VÁSÁROSNAMÉNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
